questions.title: Who is playing at 00:12:30?
questions.why: The Timeline says which song is running; the Music Ontology says who performs it and on what; the scene shows where they stand. The lighting desk and the stage manager see the same answer.

questions.title: What does the crew change between songs 3 and 4?
questions.why: Song 4 is the acoustic one. Set difference on the setlist gives the changeover list (in and out), and the stage plot shows the crew where to walk.

questions.title: Who do the followspots pick up in song 4?
questions.why: The cue sheet lives in the record; the throw from each spot to its target is in the scene. The spots and their targets light together.

inference.title: Everything on stage in Set 2
inference.why: event:sub_event nests songs in sets in the show. One rule flattens the nesting, so asking about Set 2 reaches every performer and instrument of its songs.

fault_text: The guitar amp's mic was kicked 1.65 m downstage, and the keys wedge was set on the bass side of the stage.
